_doc: Syrian local operating constraints. Every critical section must be verified by a named human with a date before Gate G1 can pass. Verification expires after max_age_days because banking and FX rules move fast. All seed entries below are CANDIDATES written without local confirmation. Replace them with what your maintenance engineers and bank actually confirm. Edit only with BOARD_MAINTENANCE=1.

electrical_brands.rule: A component is SERVICEABLE only if local_stock and local_repair are both YES, or the contract itemizes a 24 month spare parts package for it.

items.notes: Confirm licensed TIA Portal availability for local engineers
Common in regional markets. Confirm
Rewinding shops can service most IEC frame induction motors. Confirm frame sizes
Extrusion press main pumps. Critical. Confirm local rebuild capability
Licence activation may need online access from vendor servers. Confirm

items.rail: Documentary L/C via Syrian bank with foreign correspondent
items.notes: Sanctions regimes on Syria changed during 2025. Banks still de-risk. Confirm with the bank in writing which correspondent banks accept L/C confirmation today, and the vendor's bank country

items.rail: Standby L/C or bank guarantee issued by a bank outside Syria
items.notes: Often the realistic route. Confirm cost and collateral
Confirm which currencies and corridors work today

items.rail: Payment from an affiliated company abroad
items.notes: Needs transfer pricing and accounting treatment agreed with the auditor
Legal exposure. Legal_Agent must review. Cannot back a performance bond

banking_and_payment_rails.vendor_country_screening: Vendor's own bank may refuse Syrian counterparty funds. Ask every bidder for a written bank acceptance letter before shortlisting.

items.notes: Confirm current operator, average dwell time, free days before demurrage

items.topic: Industrial machinery import duty and exemptions
items.notes: Confirm investment law exemptions for production lines and the documents required
Commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, bill of lading. Confirm legalization requirements
Name, licence, past heavy machinery clearances
Press container weights may exceed standard trailers. Confirm cranes and low beds at the port

items.topic: Medium voltage supply available at site
items.notes: kV level, available MVA, utility approval lead time
Determines generator sizing. Extrusion presses and billet furnaces cannot tolerate random cuts
Transformer procurement and utility energization dates
Diesel or gas supply reliability and cost per kWh
Vendor equipment tolerance must exceed measured local variation. Require AVR and line reactors if not
Central bank bulletin. Record the rate on every journal entry
Budget at the rate you can actually obtain
Default: equipment contract in USD or EUR, civil contract in SYP with an indexation clause

Availability of PLC and hydraulic maintenance technicians
